# scc_threat_response_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing ThreatResponsePolicy object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `exchange_location` (String) Maps to the -ExchangeLocation parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `mode` (String) Maps to the -Mode parameter.
- `new_name` (String) Maps to the -NewName parameter.
- `retry_distribution` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetryDistribution parameter.
